permitTrigger.explanation: A permit is needed for a detached garage or accessory structure (other than a shed) that is 108 square feet (about 10 square metres) or larger, measured to the outside of the exterior walls, or that is attached to another structure.

questions.text: What is the floor area of the structure, measured to the outside of the exterior walls?
questions.help: 108 square feet is about 10 square metres. A 6 m by 7 m garage is 42 square metres.

questions.text: Will the structure be attached to another structure, such as your home?

requirements.label: Project description (on the application form)
requirements.plainLanguage: Describe the garage or accessory building in Section B of the application form ('Description of proposed work'): its size, use and how it will be built.

details.label: Garage project description
details.whereToAdd: Application form, Section B: 'Description of proposed work'.

requirements.label: Garage site plan
requirements.plainLanguage: A bird's-eye drawing of your lot showing the new building, existing buildings and distances to the property lines.

details.label: Proposed structure dimensions
details.whereToAdd: Site plan: write the garage length and width.

details.label: Property-line distances
details.missingMessage: A property-line measurement is missing. Add the distance from the proposed garage to the side property line.
details.whereToAdd: Site plan: dimension from the garage to the rear and both side property lines.

details.label: Other structures
details.missingMessage: The site plan is incomplete. Show the location of the existing shed.
details.whereToAdd: Site plan: draw and label every existing building, including sheds.

requirements.label: Garage construction drawings
requirements.plainLanguage: A floor plan or cross-section showing how the walls are built.

details.label: Garage construction details
details.whereToAdd: Floor plan or cross-section: note the wall construction (stud size and spacing).

requirements.label: Foundation or slab detail
requirements.plainLanguage: A drawing of the slab or footing the building sits on. The City's standard details can be used for many garages and sheds.
requirements.missingMessage: Foundation information is missing. Add the proposed foundation or slab detail.

details.label: Foundation or slab detail
details.missingMessage: Foundation information is missing. Add the proposed foundation or slab detail.
details.whereToAdd: Foundation detail or cross-section: show the slab or footing (see the City's standard details).

links.label: Standard details and guides (floating slab, mud-sill anchorage)

requirements.label: Garage elevations
requirements.plainLanguage: Drawings of each outside wall of the building, including its overall height.

details.label: Building elevations
details.whereToAdd: Elevations: include a drawing of each side of the garage.

details.label: Garage height on every elevation
details.missingMessage: One elevation is incomplete. Add the proposed garage height.
details.whereToAdd: Elevations: write the overall garage height on every elevation.
